{{Quote|''Thank you'', Commander Kungurama, for delivering us to ''Foless''&hellip; and for protecting the children from harm. You are truly kind.|[[Kuvuta Pindi]], to [[Nuru Kungurama]]|<ref name="SA" />}}
'''Foless''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Southern Core]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the periphery of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

Foless sat at the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]],<ref name="FaDCR" /> known as the [[Foless Crossroads/Legends|Foless Crossroads]].<ref name="SoL" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|284|Foless Crossroads}}</ref>

==Description==
Situated at the [[Foless Crossroads/Legends|intersection]] of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]], Foless was a large [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] center.<ref name="FaDCR" /> It was the site of the [[Foless Spaceport]],<ref name="SA" /> a massive [[stellar-class starport]].<ref name="FaDCR" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] featured an endless panorama of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and [[Forest/Legends|forests]] teeming with ferocious predators.<ref name="FaDCR" />

By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Foless boasted a population of 10 billion to 100 billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Foless was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] sometime between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Foless|battle]] won by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Foless was located in the [[Corellian Oversector]], an [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]] protected by the Galactic Republic's [[Second Army]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The appendix to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] both placed the [[Foless system/Legends|Foless system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EAOC" /> However, the Foless system was shown to be in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region on the maps of ''The Essential Atlas''.<ref name="TEA" /> This error was repeated in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'',<ref name="TEGtW" /> and also in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s core rulebooks for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series.<ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FaDCR" />
